verses.text: <pb/><t>Ku gode wa Ubangiji domin shi mai alheri ne,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<pb/>Ku gode wa Allahn da ya fi dukan alloli girma, <pb/><t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ku gode wa Ubangijin dukan iyayengiji,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce. <pb/></t>
<t>Shi kaɗai ne yake aikata mu'ujizai masu girma,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ta wurin hikimarsa ya halicci sammai,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya kafa duniya a bisa kan ruwa mai zurfi,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ne ya halicci rana da wata,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce,</t>
<t>Rana don ta yi mulkin yini,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce,</t>
<t>Wata da taurari kuwa don su yi mulkin dare,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ya karkashe 'ya'yan fari maza, na Masarawa,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ya fito da jama'ar Isra'ila daga cikin Masar,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Da ƙarfinsa da ikonsa ya fito da su,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ne ya keta Bahar Maliya biyu,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ya bi da jama'arsa ta cikin tekun,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Shi ne ya sa ruwa ya ci Fir'auna da rundunarsa,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce. <pb/></t>
<t>Ya bi da jama'arsa cikin hamada,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya karkashe sarakuna masu iko,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya karkashe shahararrun sarakuna,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya kashe Sihon, Sarkin Amoriyawa,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya kashe Og, Sarkin Bashan,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya ba da ƙasarsu ga jama'arsa,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Ya ba da ita ga bawansa Isra'ila,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce. <pb/></t>
<t>Bai manta da mu sa'ad da aka yi nasara da mu ba,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiyar ce.</t>
<t>Ya 'yantar da mu daga abokan gābanmu,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.</t>
<t>Yana ba da abinci ga dukan mutane da dabbobi,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce. <pb/></t>
<t>Ku yi wa Allah sa Sama godiya,</t> <t>Gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiyar ce.</t>
